meta.description: Registry for formal failure modes related to equivalence properties in the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: non_reflexive_context
failure_modes.description: The equivalence relation fails to satisfy reflexivity in the current process context.

failure_modes.name: symmetry_break_under_orientation
failure_modes.description: Orientation frame selection results in a loss of symmetry for the target equivalence relation.

failure_modes.name: non_transitive_equivalence
failure_modes.description: A~B and B~C do not imply A~C, violating formal equivalence requirements.

failure_modes.name: operator_destroyed_equivalence
failure_modes.description: An operator application destroys the existing equivalence class structure.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_overcollapse
failure_modes.description: Merging non-equivalent states results in information loss or formal consistency violations.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_undercollapse
failure_modes.description: Failure to merge equivalent states leads to branch explosion or non-convergence.

failure_modes.name: context_drift
failure_modes.description: The criteria for equivalence drift inconsistently under iteration or recursion.

failure_modes.name: boundary_drift_equivalence_failure
failure_modes.description: Drift in the admissibility window boundary results in previously equivalent states becoming non-equivalent.

failure_modes.name: residue_drift_equivalence_failure
failure_modes.description: Residue update dynamics destabilize the equivalence relation classes.

failure_modes.name: branch_split_equivalence_failure
failure_modes.description: Multi-valued continuation splits an equivalence class into non-equivalent branches.
